description: This file defines an S4 class 'StreamingQuery' and associated methods for managing structured streaming queries in Spark via R. It includes class definitions, method implementations for querying status, progress, and control operations like stop and await termination.

classes.name: StreamingQuery
classes.description: An S4 class representing a Spark structured streaming query, holding a Java object reference to the backend Scala StreamingQuery.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Constructor for StreamingQuery class, initializes with a Java object reference.

methods.name: streamingQuery
methods.description: Factory function to create a StreamingQuery object from a Java object reference.

methods.name: show
methods.description: Displays the name of the streaming query if available.

methods.name: queryName
methods.description: Returns the user-specified name of the streaming query.

methods.name: explain
methods.description: Prints an explanation of the streaming query plan.

methods.name: lastProgress
methods.description: Prints the most recent progress update in JSON format.

methods.name: status
methods.description: Prints the current status of the streaming query.

methods.name: isActive
methods.description: Returns TRUE if the query is actively running.

methods.name: awaitTermination
methods.description: Waits for the query to terminate, with optional timeout.
